title: Previous perfect model gives local successor-coefficient complexes
statement: Let $X$ be a locally Noetherian quasi-compact scheme, $(A,I)$ an adic coefficient datum, and $\phi_j:\underline{A/I^{j+1}}\to R_j$ coefficient isomorphisms compatible with quotient transitions and completed scalar projections. Suppose the constant module functors preserve zero morphisms. Fix a derived completed-coefficient object $M$, an etale chart $V$, integers $a\leq b$, and $n\geq0$. Assume the nth reduction has finite-perfect local models in $[a,b]$, as defined in [def-weil-pbc-finite-perfect-quotient-model-data]. Then the explicit restricted previous object $E_n$ of [def-weil-pbc-finite-quotient-coefficient-layer-data] satisfies the local homology model predicate of [def-weil-pbc-finite-coefficient-local-homology-models] over $B=A/I^{n+2}$, with comparison $\phi_{n+1}$ and support $[a,b]$. No residue-model, layer calculation, or successor-cohomology assumption is made.

theorem finiteQuotient_previous_local_complexes
    (X : Scheme.{t}) [IsLocallyNoetherian X] [CompactSpace X]
    {A : Type t} [CommRing A] (d : AdicCoefficientDatum A)
    [∀ n : ℕ, (koszulConstantFunctor X (A ⧸ d.ideal ^ (n + 1))).PreservesZeroMorphisms]
    (φ : ∀ n : ℕ, adicConstantRing X (A ⧸ d.ideal ^ (n + 1)) ⟶
      completedAdicFiniteCommRing X d n)
    (hφ : ∀ n : ℕ, IsIso (φ n)) (hcompat : FinitePerfectModelsCompatible X d φ)
    (M : DerivedCategory (CompletedAdicModules X d)) (V : X.Etale)
    (a b : ℤ) (hab : a ≤ b) (n : ℕ)
    (hprevious : FinitePerfectModelsOn X d φ M n V a b) :
    FiniteCoefficientLocalHomologyModels X (A ⧸ d.ideal ^ (n + 1 + 1))
      (φ (n + 1)) (finiteQuotientPreviousObject X d M n) V a b
